$comment: The $id base is a placeholder until round 46 (the documentation site); see element.schema.json.
title: Cytoscape.js options
description: The options of the `cytoscape( options )` factory — the envelope the element, stylesheet and layout schemas compose into — and the shape `cy.json()` exports. Unknown options are ignored by the factory, deliberately (strictness lives in the TypeScript declaration's excess-property check), so the object stays open. `elements` is the definition form: the columnar bulk form and the binary wire form are not JSON documents (the columnar schema is held until 4.x), and `container` is a DOM element, which JSON cannot carry. The slim builds (`cytoscape/headless`, `cytoscape/headless-gpu`) take the same options minus the renderer and pointer knobs.

container.description: Where to render (an HTMLElement); omitted or null, the instance is headless. JSON can carry only the null.

userZoomingEnabled.description: Allow wheel and pinch zooming (default true).

boxSelectionIncludesLabels.description: Box selection considers label boxes too (default false).

boxSelectionMode.description: What the box counts as selected: 'contain' (default, v3's) or 'overlap'.

selectionType.description: 'single' (a tap or box replaces the selection) or 'additive'.

desktopTapThreshold.description: Px a mouse press may move and still tap (default 4).

touchTapThreshold.description: Px a touch press may move and still tap (default 8).

tapholdDuration.description: An unmoved press's taphold delay in ms (default 500).

pointerCursors.description: Whether the canvas writes CSS cursors (default true), or per-state overrides ('' inherits).

headlessWidth.description: The rendered width a headless instance assumes.

headlessHeight.description: The rendered height a headless instance assumes.

pixelRatio.description: A device pixel ratio override, or 'auto' (the window's).

cursorMap.description: A CSS cursor keyword per interaction state.

renderer.description: Renderer tuning (level-of-detail values in device px).

worker.description: Host the renderer in a worker via OffscreenCanvas.
